author: jetsplat
quote: Considering the game's budget and development time, it falls far short of expectations. A "perfect" game was promised, which is why it was delayed multiple times yet it is nowhere near perfect; it is riddled with bugs, some of which appear right from the start. The story mode is merely average, failing to meet the standards one would expect from the series. There are noticeable frame-rate drops, it doesn't even hit 60fps on the PS5 Pro, and the standard PS5 struggles to maintain 30fps. The gameplay mechanics are hardly revolutionary, offering only minor improvements over GTA V, and while the map is large, there is very little environmental variety. I am deeply disappointed with Rockstar’s work, especially given the budget spent; the only decent aspect of the game is its graphics. As mentioned, the missions are lackluster compared to the rest of the series. The narrative focuses a bit too heavily on the relationship between the two protagonists, which would be fine, if this weren't a game about heists, as the title implies. The car physics are reasonably decent in terms of acceleration, but the flight mechanics for aircraft are in desperate need of an overhaul. Now, we just have to wait and see how the online mode is handled and how the game performs at full capacity on PC, though right now it doesn't even come close to the hype.
